title: Rabbi Elazar bar Berekhyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman says that only one statement of his remains, in Sanhedrin 94b: “A people that wearies itself in Torah is not handed over to its oppressor.”[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Sanhedrin 94b paragraph fully names Rabbi Elazar bar Berekhyah and contains the quoted statement. The claim that only one saying remains is explicitly Hyman’s; this comparison does not establish a corpus-wide count or a canonical biographical identity.
